verifiedAgainst.note: Verified: default context filename is GEMINI.md, overridable via the `context.fileName` key in settings.json which accepts a name or a list of names. Imports use `@file.md` syntax with relative or absolute paths, .md files only. Context files are hierarchical — the CLI concatenates all found files rather than letting the nearest win. No front matter is documented, so frontMatter.supported stays false.
